gap_notes: Valens I.1 is a topical/significator catalog (sect, colour, taste, body parts), not Ptolemy/Lilly elemental qualities. Do not backfill heat/cold/dry/moist from Valens, and do not average catalogs into function.
Valens I.1 names Venus desire and love, night sect, without elemental temperature. Ptolemy heat-with-moisture vs Lilly cold+moist stays unresolved.
Temperature conflict: Ptolemy gives Venus moisture greater than heat; Lilly names her temperately cold and moist. Do not collapse to one temperature lemma.
Object-level themes mix compared and school_specific lemmas. Per-lemma evidence_tier stays in this ledger; knowledge-object schema is not expanded for that.
Layer 1 requires positive_expression; it is filled from Lilly well-dignified manners only until a second school class is compared. Valens is still source_class=classical.

Watters 2003 is modern general practical synthesis, not Houlding/Lilly traditional and not Hand. Parked source_class=professional (classification gap; schema has no modern_general_practical). school_specific only.
Research runtime-eligibility flags are not a schema field. Body/health/fertility/medical rows stay ledger-only. Not copied into object.domains. Not runtime meaning. Planet-in-sign is Layer 5.
Watters orbit-period rows are astronomy-in-an-astrology-page, not Day Sources. Kept separate from symbolic solar-return / phase / menstrual readings on the same page.
CORE cannot be scored. Watters is school_specific modern practical, not Hand and not traditional. Greene Relating Venus chapter still closed. Do not treat more rows as consensus.
